login.title: Sign in
login.invitationOnly: Accounts are by invitation only. No account? Ask your organisation's administrator.
login.invalid: Error: the email or the password is incorrect.
login.unavailable: Error: the service is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.

invitation.intro: You have been invited as a member. Set a password to open your organisation's workspace.
invitation.notYou: Not you? Ignore this invitation; it expires on its own.
invitation.emailHelp: From your invitation; cannot be changed here.
invitation.passwordHelp: Use a long password that you do not use elsewhere.
invitation.passwordRejected: Error: the password is too short. Use a longer password.
invitation.mismatch: Error: the two passwords do not match.
invitation.invalidTitle: This invitation link cannot be used
invitation.invalidBody: The link is not valid: it may have expired, been used already or been withdrawn.
invitation.askAdmin: Ask your organisation's administrator for a new invitation.
invitation.signInIfAccount: Sign in if you already have an account.
invitation.seatBody: Your organisation has reached its seat limit, so the account cannot be created. Your invitation stays valid until it expires.
invitation.seatAskAdmin: Ask your administrator to free a seat, then open this link again.
invitation.signedInBody: Sign out before you open an invitation link.
invitation.unavailable: Error: the service is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page does not exist, or the item you asked for is not available.

failure.title: Something went wrong
failure.body: The page could not be displayed. Reload it; if the problem continues, tell your administrator.
